content_of_post_to_answer: How can I stay focused for long study hours or for one year without any distraction?
answer: Long study hours are rarely a test of willpower; they are a test of whether your environment and goals remove the need for constant decisions. The mistake is aiming for one year of perfect focus instead of building a system that makes returning easy after distractions. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for those who want a deeper look. Consistency is not never losing focus; it is shortening the time it takes to come back.
